content.summary:
**Computing walking speed medians**

I need to determine the task name from both studies since they likely share the same terminology. I'll inspect the figures or compute from the data that mentions "walking speed" and "straightness ratio," which could correspond with either study. The question asks for the higher median walking speed, so I'll need to compute medians from the relevant data in lss1_summary or lss2_summary. I’ll verify this with an analysis using Rscript, ensuring that I'm using the correct dataset.

arguments.command:
cd /code && Rscript -e 'library(tidyverse); ds1<-read_csv("/data/summary_stats_LSS1.csv", na="NaN", show_col_types=FALSE); ds1<-filter(ds1, id != 35); cat("LSS1 walk speed median:", median(ds1$walk_path_speed, na.rm=TRUE), "search:", median(ds1$search_path_speed, na.rm=TRUE), "
"); cat("LSS1 straightness median:", median(ds1$walk_straightness, na.rm=TRUE), "search:", median(ds1$search_straightness, na.rm=TRUE), "
"); ds2<-read_csv("/data/summary_stats_LSS2.csv", na = "NaN", show_col_types=FALSE); ds2<-filter(ds2, id != 212 & id != 203); cat("LSS2 walk speed median:", median(ds2$walk_path_speed, na.rm=TRUE), "search:", median(ds2$search_path_speed, na.rm=TRUE), "
"); cat("LSS2 straightness median:", median(ds2$walk_straightness, na.rm=TRUE), "search:", median(ds2$search_straightness, na.rm=TRUE), "
")' > /results/medians.txt 2>&1 && sed -n '1,120p' /results/medians.txt
